title: Complexify
description: A technology-focused modpack that enhances Minecraft with automation, machinery, and optimization. Includes Create, Mekanism, AE2, and performance mods for a more complex gameplay experience. you could say it complexify's minecraft
body:
Makes Minecraft Complex by Technology, Contains EM2, Mekanism, Create, 3D skin layers and performance mods etc. If there is a conflict, I suggest you delete Rubidium and keep Embeddium. If you like Tech. Download this (I mainly wrote this for the 3 points in the rules) and please know this is not for a Private server which I own
